additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Attock Petroleum
in your region regarding the following product:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P3 170000287
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
lPBjw9
Problem Description
: Display issue
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
03/07/2024
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Since the charger is out of warranty, the solution is to replace the HMI. Please find the spare parts with MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA03-8AA8, and refer to page 25 (content 3.3) for the adaptation kit, if required.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109814736/sicharge-d-hw-rev-0-spare-part-list?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Based on the photo you have shared; we are unable to determine whether the issue is related to quality analysis or another factor. The extended warranty for HMI-related issues (such as Delamination and HALO Effect) will only be applicable if it is confirmed that the issue is not due to vandalism and is subject to quality analysis. For more details, please refer to the links below:
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109826749/si-e-q-feedback-q2310-sicharge-d-–-controlpanel-glass-delamination?dti=0&lc=en-US
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109974921/si-e-q-feedback-q2411-sicharge-d-controlpanel-“halo”-effect?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Important
: Please use the following repair report special for HMI problems. This ensures a faster reimbursement and tracking of exchanged cases. Submit the field service report within 30 days of the incident. Refer below link for DC Spare parts RMA return process-
https://siemens.sharepoint.com/teams/eMobilityServiceCollaboration/SitePages/Return-Spares.aspx?csf=1&web=1&e=rpL361&ovuser=38ae3bcd-9579-4fd4-adda-b42e1495d55a%2Cbeerpal.singh%40siemens.com&OR=Teams-HL&CT=1734931391074&clickparams=eyJBcHBOYW1lIjoiVGVhbXMtRGVza3RvcCIsIkFwcFZlcnNpb24iOiI0OS8yNDEyMDEwMDIxMSIsIkhhc0ZlZGVyYXRlZFVzZXIiOmZhbHNlfQ%3D%3D&CID=4f4270a1-80eb-a000-c123-59f86f7c47f2&cidOR=SPO
